description: Add one record to a Civo-hosted domain. Live DNS changes propagate to the world; undo by deleting the record in the Civo dashboard or CLI. Civo: POST /v2/dns/{domain_id}/records.

name.description: The subdomain part, e.g. www, or @ for the apex.

ttl.description: TTL in seconds; Civo's minimum and default is 600.

value.description: An IP address, hostname or text value.

name: civo_create_dns_record
title: Add a DNS record
